JSON-friendly alphagraph graph model

Source: R/class_graph.R
AlphaGraph.Rd

R6 container for a canonical alphagraph graph definition. The internal data model is a plain R list that can be serialized with jsonlite and converted to graphicalMCP inputs, editable transition matrices, and visNetwork data.

Value

An R6 class generator.

Details

Create an instance with AlphaGraph$new(). Nodes represent hypotheses, edges represent directed transitions, and nested vis fields hold presentation properties. Symbolic drafts remain editable; numeric validation is required before passing inputs to graphicalMCP. Mutating methods return the instance invisibly unless their description states otherwise.

AlphaGraph$new()

Initialize an empty canonical graph with default presentation settings.

Usage

AlphaGraph$new(
  id = "graph",
  label = id,
  description = NULL,
  metadata = list(),
  settings = list()
)

Arguments

id

Character scalar identifying the object within its collection.

label

Human-readable character label.

description

Optional character description; NULL omits it.

metadata

Named list of JSON-compatible metadata; empty by default.

settings

Named list of graph settings merged with the defaults.

AlphaGraph$addNode()

Add a hypothesis with a stable identifier, weight, and presentation properties.

Usage

AlphaGraph$addNode(
  id,
  label = id,
  weight = 0,
  weightLabel = NULL,
  weightExpression = NULL,
  weightValue = NULL,
  x = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  visLabel = NULL,
  shape = "circle",
  colorBackground = "white",
  colorBorder = "black",
  borderWidth = 2,
  fontSize = 14,
  vis = list(),
  metadata = list(),
  replace = FALSE
)

Arguments

id

Character scalar identifying the object within its collection.

label

Human-readable character label.

weight

Numeric weight, fraction string, or symbolic expression.

weightLabel

Optional character display label for the hypothesis weight.

weightExpression

Optional character expression for the hypothesis weight.

weightValue

Optional numeric value for the hypothesis weight.

x

Numeric scalar or fraction string to parse or format.

y

Vertical numeric coordinate, or NULL for automatic placement.

visLabel

Optional character network label; derived from label and weight by default.

shape

Character visNetwork node shape; defaults to "circle".

colorBackground

Node background color; defaults to "white".

colorBorder

Node border color; defaults to "black".

borderWidth

Numeric node border width; defaults to 2.

fontSize

Numeric label font size in pixels.

vis

Named list of additional visNetwork presentation properties.

metadata

Named list of JSON-compatible metadata; empty by default.

replace

Logical; whether an existing identifier may be replaced.

AlphaGraph$updateFromTransitionMatrix()

Update transitions while preserving canonical hypothesis order.

Usage

AlphaGraph$updateFromTransitionMatrix(
  transitions,
  type = c("expression", "display", "value"),
  nodeKeys = c("id", "label"),
  removeZero = TRUE,
  validate = TRUE
)

Arguments

transitions

Square transition matrix or data frame in hypothesis order.

type

Character choice of "value", "expression", or "display" representation.

nodeKeys

Character choice of "id" or "label" used to match matrix dimnames.

removeZero

Logical; whether zero cells remove existing edges. Defaults to TRUE.

validate

Logical; whether to validate the imported, returned, or modified object.

AlphaGraph$toTransitionMatrix()

Return an n by n transition matrix or data frame in canonical node order.

Usage

AlphaGraph$toTransitionMatrix(
  type = c("display", "value", "expression"),
  parameters = list(),
  asDataFrame = TRUE,
  rowNames = c("label", "id"),
  zero = NULL,
  validate = FALSE
)

Arguments

type

Character choice of "value", "expression", or "display" representation.

parameters

Named list of numeric parameter overrides for expression evaluation.

asDataFrame

Logical; return a data frame when TRUE, a matrix otherwise.

rowNames

Character choice of "label" or "id" for row and column names.

zero

Optional fill value for missing transitions; defaults to numeric or character zero.

validate

Logical; whether to validate the imported, returned, or modified object.

AlphaGraph$clone()

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

Usage

AlphaGraph$clone(deep = FALSE)

Arguments

deep

Whether to make a deep clone.

Examples

graph <- createDemoAlphaGraph()
graph$validate(requireNumeric = TRUE)
#> [1] TRUE
graph$toTransitionMatrix(type = "value", rowNames = "id")
#>       H1_NI H1_S H2_NI H2_S
#> H1_NI     0  0.5   0.5  0.0
#> H1_S      0  0.0   0.5  0.5
#> H2_NI     0  0.5   0.0  0.5
#> H2_S      0  0.0   0.0  0.0
